scope: Primary methodological guidance, not a new clinical search

sources.paraphrase: When information remains incomplete or unobtainable after reasonable attempts, list the relevant studies as awaiting classification. This does not establish ineligibility.
Report records, retrieval, unretrieved reports, eligibility decisions and included studies/reports. Reports and studies are separate units.
The standard template distinguishes reports and studies; a unique participant total is not a mandatory flow-box field.

interpretation_not_claimed_as_official_c: A final review can transparently retain unavailable and unclassifiable material. This does not establish the missing age, initial N or cohort identity facts, or endorse journal acceptance.
